python3 -c '
import cv2, numpy as np
img = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0075.png")

# Let us find all pixels where color is table brown:
# Table brown: R in [60, 140], G in [30, 80], B in [10, 40]
mask = (img[:,:,2] > 60) & (img[:,:,2] < 140) & (img[:,:,1] > 30) & (img[:,:,1] < 80) & (img[:,:,0] < 40)
# Find connected components or columns where y > 330:
bottom_ys = []
for x in range(img.shape[1]):
    ys = np.where(mask[:, x])[0]
    if len(ys) > 0 and ys.max() > 330:
        bottom_ys.append((x, ys.max()))

import itertools
from operator import itemgetter

for k, g in itertools.groupby(enumerate(bottom_ys), lambda ix: ix[0] - ix[1][0]):
    group = list(map(itemgetter(1), g))
    xs = [p[0] for p in group]
    ys = [p[1] for p in group]
    print(f"Leg cluster: x in [{min(xs)}, {max(xs)}], max_y = {max(ys)}, mean_x = {np.mean(xs):.1f}")
'
